newsitem.title: HONG KONG: State St, Mansion House form JV.
newsitem.headline: State St, Mansion House form JV.

text.p: State Street Bank and Trust Co and Mansion House Group of Hong Kong said they have formed a joint venture company to provide asset management and mutual fund services relating to Hong Kong, China and the region.
State Street Bank is the principal subsidiary of State Street Corp of the United States.
The new company, State Street Mansion House Investment Management Services, is equally owned by State Street and Mansion House, the companies said in a joint statement.
Nicholas Lopardo, chairman and chief executive officer of State Street Global Advisors, the investment management group of State Street, is chairman of the new firm.
Evans Lowe, chairman and chief executive officer of Mansion House, is vice chairman.
State Street Global Advisors manages more than US$300 billion in assets worldwide, it said.
Mansion House is active in stock brokerage, asset management and direct investment in China.
